title: Research: sharp COPY69 for the A2+E6 nine-normal P112 decoder
body:
## Result

Sharp **COPY69** for PR1224's fixed **A2-weight + E6 root-basis nine-normal decoder on standard P112**, with arbitrary independent complex per-root kernel shifts and ordinary transpose. The all-nine-active rational witness has term costs `(1,8,8,8,8,9,9,9,9)` and differs from the dropped-first-term base only by `t_45=-4`.

This resolves the named A2+E6 follow-up explicitly left in PR1304 and PR1612. It is not a finite coefficient-box extension, the A8-simplex result, retained-coordinate sparse-lift PR1325, or the partition-gauge PR1962/1988 family.

### Proof and evidence

Six forced terms cost 52. The three variable column supports have full binary label rank, so their cost is `27 - sum(kernel dimensions)`. A complete 512-character compatibility census shows that any kernel of dimension at least three forces both other nonzero kernels onto a unique exceptional one-dimensional pair. With the separately handled zero-kernel cases, the total deficiency is at most ten, hence variable cost at least 17. The all-active witness attains 69.

The package contains the written proof, exact finite certificate, independent geometry/character-basis implementation, actual support-pair charges, 12,544 all-pairs rational identities per checker, semantic negative controls and full chooser/source/replay metadata.

The complete optimistic **conditional fixed-noncentre** screen already fails at the elementary COPY65 bound. COPY69 sharpens its root to `[1452819253108,1452819253109]/10^15`, even granting fractional rank-nine centres and zero added interface overhead. The independent integer-power bound gives moment `>=15238506806272258653/15232000000000000000 > 1` at `a=1/625`.

**No new physical supplier, selected frontier or kappa is claimed.** The theorem fixes one normal basis and puncture, all-pairs exactness and separate term charges. Other normals, masks, shared physical copies and changed noncentre work remain outside scope.

## Validation

CPython **3.12.12**, darwin arm64, standard library only:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/a2-e6-nine-normal-floor/verify.py --write
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/a2-e6-nine-normal-floor
```

Observed: primary certificate PASS; independent geometry/basis and integer-power replay PASS; **six semantic test groups PASS**; optimized `-O` replay PASS; `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Parent independently reviewed the proof and replayed all four registered commands before publication. No selected cold replay, Lean/kernel acceptance, independent human review or hosted-CI success is asserted.
